calebanderson-coder-ai-agency-os-starter.description: Create and maintain an isolated workspace per client, with a client CLAUDE.md holding brand voice, rules, banned claims, contacts, access map, and logs. Use when adding a client, switching clients, or when Claude must "act as" a specific client.
Write B2B cold emails and 4-step follow-up sequences that sell AI/automation services to US SMBs. Use when the user asks for cold outreach, a prospecting sequence, or reply-rate fixes.

Design an irresistible, productized AI-service offer (value stack, guarantee, pricing ladder) for freelancers and agencies. Use when the user asks to package a service, set prices, or "make my offer better".

Get a fast value-based price for an AI/automation project from 6 numbers about the client's workflow, with the math shown and an underquote check. Use when the user asks "what should I charge", "price this", "is $X too low", or is about to send a quote.

Check any client request against the contracted scope, flag out-of-scope work, and draft a polite change order with price and timeline. Use whenever a client asks for something new, "quick", "small", "extra", or "while you're at it".
